units: Y. Kil. VIII, 31ᶜ bot. (ref. to רמך, v. preced.) ר׳ דלא כלינס the rammakh is one that brooks no bridle (effrenis, v. Plin. Hist. Nat. VIII, 69).—Pl. רַמָּכִין, רַמָּכַיָּא, רַמָּכֵי.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 8:10">Targ. Esth. VIII, 10</cite>; Targ. II Esth.
<cite ref="Taanit 23a:16">Taan. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>חזא חמריה … ר׳ ר׳</he> (Ḥoni after seventy years’ sleep) saw his ass to whom had been born several generations of mules.
